en.headline: Cathay Pacific cancels Dubai and Riyadh flights until end of November
en.dek: The carrier said passenger services to the two Middle East destinations remain suspended through 30 November 2026 because of the latest regional developments, with free rebooking, rerouting or refunds offered to affected travellers.
body: Cathay Pacific announced on Friday that its passenger flights to and from Dubai and Riyadh have been cancelled up to and including 30 November 2026.
The airline cited the latest developments in the Middle East as the reason for the extended suspension. Affected travellers will be offered the flexibility to rebook, reroute or refund their tickets.

Cathay said it would continue to closely monitor the evolving situation in the region. The decision follows earlier postponements of the planned resumption of services that had been scheduled for September.

zh.headline: 國泰取消往返迪拜及利雅得航班至11月底
zh.dek: 國泰航空表示，因應中東最新事態發展，往返迪拜及利雅得的客運航班將取消至2026年11月30日，受影響旅客可免費改期、改道或退款。
body: 國泰航空周五公布，往返迪拜及利雅得的客運航班已取消至2026年11月30日（包括當日）。
航空公司指，決定因應中東最新事態發展而作出。受影響旅客可獲靈活安排，包括免費改期、改道或退款。
國泰表示會繼續密切監察區內情況。有關取消是繼早前押後原定9月恢復服務的安排後再作延長。
